scripts.translate: npm run translate:pot && npm run translate:update
scripts.translate:pot: npm run translate:acf && wp i18n make-pot . ./resources/lang/sage.pot --include="app,resources/views,resources/lang/acf-json.php,theme.json,style.css" --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"","Language-Team":""}'
scripts.translate:update: for file in ./resources/lang/*.po; do wp i18n update-po ./resources/lang/sage.pot $file; done
scripts.translate:compile: npm run translate:mo && npm run translate:php && npm run translate:js
